note: Hand-reviewed decisions for every wallet in the near-connect manifest (slice W6, part 2). Hosts come from reading each executor (scripts/wallets-refresh.mjs prints every host with its line and column); a wallet is enabled only if it passes the rules in docs/WALLETS.md. Changing this file is a reviewed change.

ledger.reason: Requests the usb, hid and bluetooth permissions for a sandboxed frame. Veylo does not grant hardware permissions to wallet code, so it is excluded.

trezu-wallet.reason: Its manifest entry declares no signMessage, and a multisig contract account cannot produce the NEP-413 signature Veylo needs (see docs/ECOSYSTEM.md).

wallet-connect.reason: Requires the walletConnect permission, which needs a configured WalletConnect project and relay hosts. Veylo has neither, and adds no third-party relay to the bridge.

unity-wallet.reason: Uses the same WalletConnect executor as wallet-connect (identical SHA-256), so it is excluded for the same reason.

hana-wallet.reason: Its executor is served from a feature branch of a third-party repository, not a release, so its content can change without a version. Excluded until it is released.

ethereum-wallets.reason: Its manifest entry declares signMessage false: an EVM wallet through evm-on-near cannot produce the NEP-413 signature Veylo needs.

near-cli.reason: A connector for the near-cli command-line tool, a developer tool rather than a wallet for the people Veylo serves.
